deadline.intake: September 2027, non-EU applicants (programme page: Global Sustainability Science)

tuition.note: Non-EU institutional fee amount only in a PDF not opened; statutory fee EUR 2694 (2026-27) applies to EU/EEA only

requirement.text: Non-EU applicants need passport scan, proof of qualifications meeting entry requirements, EMI-ready English proficiency (test scores may follow conditionally) and EUR 100 application fee via Studielink.
